Name: Gyroid Scarecrows for Json Assets
Author: whitebalverines
Description:
[center]This adds nine new scarecrows and one deluxe scarecrow!
(the Brewstoid is the deluxe)
You can buy the crafting recipe from Marnie and they take 5 clay to make.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZzZjY1b.png[/img]﻿

I added a selection of my favorite gyroids from the animal crossing series to spook the crows and add some character to the farm :P

I plan to make an animated version of them soon so that they can do their nifty little dance lol

Requires Content Patcher and Json Assets
Place [JA] folder into your mods and you're good to go![/center]

Downloads.Description: Place [JA] folder in your mods folder
